title: SEM Experiment — 2019-09
description: Demo schema for JSON Schema Draft 2019-09. Highlights: '$defs' replaces 'definitions', $ref siblings are now honored, exclusiveMinimum/Maximum become standalone numbers (not boolean modifiers), 'dependencies' becomes 'dependentRequired', and 'unevaluatedProperties' is introduced. Tuple syntax still uses items-array (same as Draft-07).

DeviceModel.title: Device Model
DeviceModel.description: SEM device model used in the experiment.

Operator.title: Operator Name
Operator.description: Full name of the operator running the instrument.

SEMParameters.title: SEM Parameters
SEMParameters.description: Acquisition parameters set on the instrument.

AccelerationVoltage.title: Acceleration Voltage [kV]
AccelerationVoltage.description: 2019-09: $ref and its sibling keywords are merged. Both this field's 'minimum: 10' AND the $defs/voltage constraints (minimum: 0, maximum: 30) are applied together. In Draft-07 the siblings would have been silently ignored.

ProbeCurrent.title: Probe Current [nA]
ProbeCurrent.description: 2019-09 exclusive bound: 'exclusiveMinimum' is now a standalone numeric keyword (not a boolean). 'exclusiveMinimum: 0' means value must be strictly greater than 0. No companion 'minimum' needed.

BeamEnergy.title: Beam Energy [eV]
BeamEnergy.description: 2019-09 exclusive upper bound: 'exclusiveMaximum' is a standalone number. Value must be strictly less than 30000. 'multipleOf' constrains the value to increments of 100.

WorkingDistance.title: Working Distance [mm]
WorkingDistance.description: Distance from the final lens pole piece to the specimen surface. Providing this field makes ProbeCurrent required (see 'dependentRequired' on the parent object).

ProbeDiameter.title: Probe Diameter [nm]
ProbeDiameter.description: Estimated diameter of the electron probe at the specimen surface. Plain inclusive minimum — contrast with ProbeCurrent which uses an exclusive minimum.

DetectorMode.title: Detector Mode
DetectorMode.description: Secondary electron (SE), backscattered electron (BSE), or STEM detector mode.

SampleLabel.title: Sample Label
SampleLabel.description: Alphanumeric identifier for the sample. Pattern enforced via regex.

ScanSequence.title: Scan Sequence (Tuple)
ScanSequence.description: 2019-09 tuple syntax: still uses 'items' as an array of schemas, same as Draft-07. Position 0 = dwell time, 1 = line count, 2 = direction. In 2020-12 this changes to 'prefixItems'.
